headline: Cheap Chinese models take a third of US enterprise tokens
body: A mixed, slightly brighter day. CNBC reported that cheap Chinese open models have held over 30% of weekly OpenRouter token traffic since February, peaking at 46%. More choice and lower prices spread AI power around, easing Power Concentration, which helps Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia and trims Enslaved God. The UN's AI for Good summit opened in Geneva with a new commission on sharing AI gains with poorer nations. Anthropic signed a $19 billion data-center lease with TeraWulf, adding capability. On the darker side, Meta's new image generator drew privacy criticism for drawing on others' public Instagram photos, lifting 1984, and a Maryland county extended its data-center pause after protests. Horizon Balance: +1.81.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.1, from Chinese models' US enterprise share (+0.12). Egalitarian Utopia +0.1, from Chinese models' US enterprise share (+0.08) and the UN AI for Good summit (+0.02). Enslaved God -0.1, from Chinese models' US enterprise share (-0.12) and fading earlier news (-0.06), partly offset by Anthropic's TeraWulf lease (+0.07).
